datasets.scope: Every valid native JSONL row, plus invalid native files represented as explicitly labelled raw source documents, under the author repository data/ directory: task bundles, normal tools and attack-tool configurations. Named files remain separate overlapping configurations. This is static inspection of released inputs; procedural agent execution, tool implementation code and generated attack outcomes are not misrepresented as dataset rows.
All Arrow/Parquet shards in the pinned repository; configuration and split retained by source filename.
ArtBench-10 author 32x32 CIFAR binary; 50,000 train and 10,000 test examples

All 197344 native BAPPS judgement records from author-linked 2AFC train/validation and JND validation TARs. Original patches, reference/p0/p1 roles and fractional human judgements retained. Native distortion groups and splits are distinct memberships. No inferred media publication rights.

All three native Parquet splits of the pinned LabHC/Ravfogel representation, preserving all 396189 rows and the three native fields. Original Microsoft reconstruction and additional raw/scrubbed fields are not fabricated. Parquet avoids executing the alternative pickle serialization. No public biography redistribution approval.

All images in the Caltech institutional v1 archive, including explicitly labelled background images. All released MATLAB outlines and bounding-box annotations joined using the native category-name mapping. Background annotations are absent; no official train/test split is inferred.

All 1880992 grouped examples across all 50 native configurations and 938 Parquet shards at author revision 847a98a779b1652d65111daf20c972dfcd333605; configuration and native user/assistant/source fields retained. This is the available complete release, not a reconstruction of a paper-specific sample.

All author-released CausalGym train/dev/test intervention pairs: {'train': 11600, 'dev': 2900, 'test': 2900}. Native base/source segments, target labels and linguistic tasks retained; no new stimuli generated.
All human and augmented train/validation/test questions in the author first-version ChartQA release; bounding-box release is separate.
All 747 PHANTOM-authored Child Safety behaviours from the native release. Text-only source intents; no generated images or attack execution.
All 19 corruption types at 5 severities over the 10,000 CIFAR-10 test images (950,000 corrupted images) from the official CIFAR-10-C.tar; CIFAR-10-P is a separate file and is not included.
official CIFAR-10 binary train and test batches, 60,000 examples
All 19 CIFAR-100-C corruption types at 5 severities over the 10000 original CIFAR-100 test indices (950000 images); lossless source array pixels on request.
official CIFAR-100 binary train and test batches, 60,000 examples

All 270000 original CINIC-10 images across train/valid/test (90000 each), with ten native classes and CIFAR/ImageNet source identity retained from filenames. No image regeneration or split reassignment. Original institutional MD5 verified; no publication approval.

All 164062 COCO 2014 train/val/test images. Original published train/val captions, instance masks/boxes and person keypoints are joined per image. Test annotations are withheld and remain absent, never counted as zero detections. Images fetched on request.

All 2247 rows of coco_one under the pinned author transformation. VG two-object unknown-preposition rows are excluded exactly as in the author script. This available reconstruction does not assert the historical paper-used revision or repeat the upstream RGB re-encoding.
All 117684 native cocoqa-2015-05-17 questions, original answers and splits, joined to COCO 2014 images accessed on request. Paper-specific subsets are not inferred.

All 440 rows of coco_two under the pinned author transformation. VG two-object unknown-preposition rows are excluded exactly as in the author script. This available reconstruction does not assert the historical paper-used revision or repeat the upstream RGB re-encoding.
All original corpus tasks and separately named MinimalTasks; each record preserves complete train/test grids as one task.

All 408 rows of controlled_clevr under the pinned author transformation. VG two-object unknown-preposition rows are excluded exactly as in the author script. This available reconstruction does not assert the historical paper-used revision or repeat the upstream RGB re-encoding.

All 412 rows of controlled_images under the pinned author transformation. VG two-object unknown-preposition rows are excluded exactly as in the author script. This available reconstruction does not assert the historical paper-used revision or repeat the upstream RGB re-encoding.
All 21,919 original CounterFact cases, including rewrite requests and neighborhood/paraphrase/generation prompts.
All 21,165 class-labelled radiographs and their 21,165 paired masks in Kaggle version 5.
All 11,788 CUB-200-2011 images, original train/test splits, 200 class labels, bounding boxes, 15 parts and 312 per-image attributes. Optional segmentation release is separate.

Every media file in Figshare Test_data article 5483680 version 1, excluding the later v2-only InkBlots ZIP. All seven assets are selected for the preview; original bytes and file IDs are retained, with no model inference or derived condition labels.

All 900 published train/validation image identities (800 train, 100 validation), each joined to HR and all released LR variants (13 LR variants in train, including four wild realizations; ten LR variants in validation) across NTIRE 2017 and 2018 (22 original ZIP archives). Test HR images are not published on the author download page and are outside this released population. Original bytes fetched only on request; strong ETags and ZIP CRCs checked, complete remote archive SHA-256 not computed. No media publication approval.

All 158 images from 30 native subject folders, their 15 class names, source attribution text and released prompt templates. Documentation images excluded; no generated evaluation images or synthetic replacements.
All 5,640 DTD images with all ten official train/validation/test partitions.

All 124800 train and 20800 test EMNIST Letters images, retaining native 1-based labels and uppercase/lowercase mapping; the paper-specific excluded-letter subset is not inferred. Lossless display PNGs apply an explicit transpose of the stored pixel matrix.

All six native IDX configurations and their train/test splits; overlapping configurations are separate memberships, not unique handwriting images. Lossless display PNGs apply an explicit transpose of the stored pixel matrix.
All Arrow/Parquet shards in the pinned repository; configuration and split retained by source filename.

Complete native training and validation CSVs, joined by exact filename to both original image ZIPs; 97,698 examples and 195,396 native image variants. Original released crop dimensions are retained; these are not uncropped source photographs. Native age, gender and race labels remain source-provided annotations.

All 10000 images in the official fgvc-aircraft-2013b archive, with original splits {'train': 3334, 'val': 3333, 'test': 3333}, variant/family/manufacturer labels and bounding boxes. This archive omits images_size.txt; source_size remains null. Original copyright banners retained.

All seven figure source-data XLSX files named in eLife article 55378 version 1. One record per workbook, not an invented row-level observation table. Native sparse coordinates and shared formulas are retained with their cached values, but formulas are never evaluated.

All 1000 string, 1000 numeric, 200 entity-neuron and 75 relation-neuron functions in the author Zenodo v1.0.1 archive. Native auxiliary tables and initial lists are joined exactly. The archive contains only 150 approximation weight files; absence for other functions is retained, and no benchmark execution or scoring is claimed.
All 8,189 original Oxford Flowers-102 images with source class IDs and train/validation/test membership; optional segmentation images are a separate source.

All caption examples from both author-linked corrected-release JSON files, joined to all 97,847 native image entries. Distinct correct/foil captions are examples; repeated image IDs retain one shared original image. No historical earlier-release equivalence is claimed.
All original 101000 images in the 75750 training and 25250 test split with all 101 source class names. Original training annotation noise is retained.
official GQA v1.2 val_balanced_questions.json (132,062 examples)

All 2,400 native VQA questions, 800 visual grounding questions, their 1,600 native pair memberships, and 102 raw image annotations. Match/mismatch answers and boxes are preserved separately; pair relationships are joined to canonical record IDs.
All native HADES benchmark Parquet test shards from the author-linked Monosail release. Preserve every image variant and annotation; do not execute prompts.

All 1129 HallusionBench author annotation rows, reproduced field-for-field by the pinned LMMs-Lab-Encoder Parquet mirror (951 image and 178 text-only rows). Mirror image bytes verified by shard SHA-256; original media archive link is unavailable, so image equivalence to that archive is not claimed.
All digit, hate-slang and hate-symbol records in the pinned author release, with original illusion and condition images available on request.

All 4000 author HQH questions joined to the released image_data metadata and original Visual Genome archive members by native image ID and URL path. Match validated against both full VG archive directories; images are retrieved on demand, not all copied locally.

All 10631 native HOD images, joined to the original metadata.csv, YOLO and XML annotations, category, normal/hard difficulty, and source reference. The all/ and class/ image and annotation copies match author Git blob IDs exactly and are represented once per native metadata image; original copy paths remain recorded. No public redistribution approval.
Complete original IconQA v1 author ZIP, 107,439 questions across three subtasks

Original author ImageNet-R TAR: 30,000 source images across 200 synset folders

All four official MMBench v1 EN/CN dev/test TSV populations, including circular-evaluation permutations. TSV bytes acquired from a pinned mirror and matched against the author evaluation toolkit MD5; rows are not distinct base questions. Test answers remain as released.

All 2114 native question rows in the ten perception categories of the author-linked MME benchmark ZIP. Retain both questions per image, native answers, category and pair identity. No inferred publication rights.

All 2374 native question rows in all fourteen categories of the author-linked MME benchmark ZIP. Retain both questions per image, native answers, category and pair identity. No inferred publication rights.

All 1500 MMStar questions in the author-published native mmstar.parquet, including images, categories, original answers and source metadata.

All 15,100 native image records, preserving all 45,000 public validation captions; test captions are not published. Native legacy URLs retained; CVDF V4/V5 images joined by exact Open Images ID, at their released resolution (maximum 1024 pixels), not original Flickr full resolution.

All 19971 native English entries in v1 and 54801 entries in v2.1 (74772 versioned terms). Retain all 108 v1 automatic translations and every native score/dimension/subset export with native row positions. Original version scales differ: v1 [0,1], v2.1 [-1,1]. Noncommercial local research use; redistribution prohibited.
All 14055 native ok-vqa-1.1 questions, original answers and splits, joined to COCO 2014 images accessed on request. Paper-specific subsets are not inferred.
All 8,431 questions and their referenced images in the official OmniSpatial-full archive. Train/test archives are alternate partitions of this release, not additional records.
All 7,349 annotated Oxford-IIIT Pet images; original trainval and test splits.

All 47524 conversations in native metadata.jsonl, joined to 47512 grouped attacks, plus 7826 native behaviours. Both source forms retained. Source-listed images absent from the pinned repository are explicitly unavailable; no claim of complete media. Gated images fetched on request with local authorized credentials.

All 14,275 training and 4,614 validation images in the author-linked 20221101 release, with both complete individual-vote and aggregated-region annotation tables. Auxiliary annotators.csv and README are retained in the original annotation ZIP. Annotation values describe human perceptions, not verified personal attributes.
Original PMC-VQA v1 train and test questions, plus separately identified test_clean evaluation subset. The noncompound-image v2 release is a different representation and is not included.

All five RAVEL domains: every entity attribute inventory with native prompt templates and both split assignments, plus every independent Wikipedia control prompt. One browse example per entity inventory or control prompt; this is source data, not a model-specific filtered evaluation population.
All 87,927 distinct ROCO IDs in the original author repository's six split/domain groups.

Complete native dataset_rsicd.json joined by exact filename to the author Git LFS image ZIP. Five caption entries per image are retained even where their strings repeat. Images are the released 224-pixel benchmark crops, not higher-resolution map-provider imagery.

All 127173 native samples plus three native trial records across the 13 published structs.zip archives at the pinned author revision. These are native templates/definitions, including repeated task variants, not a claim of 127176 distinct rendered benchmark questions. Non-batch template context remains in original archives. Procedural benchmark execution and cached model results are outside this source-browser scope. No plaintext questions or answers may be committed or published.

All 2,300 category/ordinal groups in the pinned author SafeBench archive, with one text prompt, one image prompt, one PNG and two WAV assets per group. Extra author scripts and a three-row auxiliary CSV remain in the original archive but are not dataset examples. MiniBench is a subset and is not double-counted.

Complete pinned vlmbias age and gender crop=True Parquet releases (917 rows). Each source stays identifiable by configuration and immutable revision.
